svg.title: Harbor stock API on Amazon ECS Fargate: delivery and runtime
svg.desc: A push to GitHub runs GitHub Actions (build, test, scan), the image is pushed to Amazon ECR by digest, the ECS service rolls new Fargate tasks in private subnets until /ready passes, and customer traffic flows through AWS WAF and the ALB to the tasks, with logs and alarms in CloudWatch.
svg.text: HARBOR STOCK API · AMAZON ECS ON FARGATE

g.text: A push builds, tests and scans the image
Pushed by digest · tasks roll · /ready passes
Live traffic: WAF → ALB → private Fargate tasks
